styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.intro: Overview of color tokens, typography and base components before building the pages.
styleguide.heroTitle: Where the forest meets slow water.
styleguide.buttonsNote: Three everyday buttons. The laterite accent is reserved for a single button per page: the booking one.
styleguide.imagesNote: Controlled ratio, slightly rounded corners, contrast overlay and overlaid caption — one treatment, reused everywhere.
styleguide.spacingNote: Consistent spacing scale (4 → 64 px) and a text column capped at 65-75 characters for readability.
styleguide.columnSample: The text column is meant to stay between 65 and 75 characters wide: enough room to breathe, short enough not to tire the eye on long reads, on mobile as on desktop.
styleguide.formNote: Preview of the future booking form fields (step 5): name, date, number of people, activity, message.
styleguide.sampleCardBody: A calm ride through the flooded forest paths, with a local guide.
